sample_unit: emergency department cases with abdominal complaints

links.outcome: Agreement of ChatGPT imaging referral recommendations with ESR iGuide clinical decision support on same cases
links.effect: ChatGPT recommendations were consistent with ESR iGuide; disagreement in 12.4% of cases; high agreement between ChatGPT and specialists on CAP CT cases (n=66).
links.quote: ChatGPT recommendations were consistent with the recommendations provided by the ESR iGuide.

screen.reason: Empirical study comparing ChatGPT's recommendations for imaging test referrals against an established clinical decision support system (ESR iGuide) and specialist review using retrospective emergency department cases.
